title: Event-Sourced Admin Ledger + Guided Remediation (Troubleshooter)
creator: Maya Patel
description: Build an event-sourced "Troubleshooter" subsystem (admin ledger) that records operator actions and system-side events, enables deterministic replay of incidents, and surfaces guided remediation paths in Console and the admin CLI. This ticket covers the core ledger schema, replay API, a small set of safety-checked remediation templates, RBAC/audit hooks, and a Console surface that suggests next steps during an ongoing incident.
acceptance_criteria: Ledger API ingests operator actions and system events with schema v1 and persists to the event store (S3+indexing) within 2s for typical write size
Replay API can reconstruct a request sequence for a 60s window and produce a deterministic dry-run output in staging (no side-effects)
Console shows contextual remediation suggestions for at least 3 common ops flows (restart worker, scale pool, revoke token) and links to the exact event sequence
All operator actions captured include actor, timestamp, pre/post snapshots (diff), and correlation IDs for auditability
RBAC prevents non-admin users from executing guided remediation steps in production; audit logs retained per compliance retention policy
End-to-end telemetry (trace, metrics) for ledger ingestion, replay latency, and remediation success rate is visible on dashboard runtime-ops/ledger
implementation_notes: Prototype using an append-only event format (JSONL) keyed by correlation_id. Use existing telemetry pipeline for indexing (Kafka -> elasticsearch). For deterministic replay, sandbox flows in a read-only 'dry-run' mode that calls the runtime in simulation; actual side-effecting operations require an explicit two-step approval. We will reuse existing auth hooks and the operator CLI plugin model. Storage: small events (<=8KB) persisted; consider compaction for long-lived sessions. Trade-offs: event-store simplicity vs. richer structured DB for queries; we chose S3+indexing for durability and cheap retention with a future plan to add Cassandra for hot windows.
tests_plan: Unit tests for serializer/deserializer, property-based tests for replay determinism, integration tests against a staging runtime that exercises restart/scale flows in dry-run mode, and e2e tests for Console UI rendering using Playwright. Also add fuzzing for malformed events and a chaos test that simulates partial event loss; test must flag non-deterministic replays.
rollout_plan: 1) Merge feature flag behind `ops.troubleshooter` in staging. 2) Internal dogfood by Oncall and SRE for two weeks. 3) Enable guided remediation templates for a single low-risk flow (scale pool) in dedicated sandbox. 4) Gradual production opt-in for a small set of operator users. 5) Audit review and compliance sign-off, then wide rollout. Each step gated by automated checks: ingestion latency <2s, replay determinism pass rate 99.9%, and no unauthorized execs.
